card.name: Characters inside random codes and numbers
card.fires_on: Single characters or short chunks inside hash-like IDs, hex codes, passwords and numeric strings, plus the copyright sign and a few scattered words. Mostly the marked piece sits in the middle of an unpredictable code.

modes.label: Inside ID strings
modes.description: A letter or digit within a random-looking hash, URL parameter or password.

modes.label: Numbers and dates
modes.description: A digit or space just before or within a number, time or page range.

modes.label: Copyright sign
modes.description: The © symbol right after the word Copyright.

card.plain: It fires on stray characters inside codes, IDs and numbers, where the next piece is hard to predict.
